system.description:
The classic elder power to communicate at great distances via the Madness Network. The Malkavian can link a number of people together, though everyone involved must converse out loud, and each participant hears the others as if they stood next to them regardless of actual distance.

MET System: Without cell phones or radios to simulate this over real distances, this power is recommended for Storyteller/Narrator use only — for example, a Narrator approaching a player with a message transmitted via Babble, rather than two distant players attempting to genuinely converse.
